topic: Two siblings inherit their grandmother's house
text: Hey, I just can't stop thinking about the house. I mean, it's so much, more than I ever thought we'd have to deal with. I know we should be happy, right? Grandma wanted us to have a place to call our own, a piece of history to pass down. But, I keep worrying about the responsibility, the upkeep, everything. It’s like, what if we can’t live up to it? What if we mess up her memory somehow? I wish she was here to tell us what to do, you know? I just feel like we need to be really careful, make the right choices. Can we maybe talk more about this, about what we really want to do?
